column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/delay_receiver_values.onsa tests=15 evaluated=15 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ prev~(x).when~(c) runs where c holds and keeps its last output where it does not (the output before the first run is T.default())
process 0 frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[true false true true false]
process 1 frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[false false false false false]
process 2 frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[true true true true true]
@ a delay that has not run reads T.default(), not its init; the first run reads the init (R4)
process 0 frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[false false true true false]
process 1 frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[true true false true true]
@ the length of a delay counts the frames it ran: delay~(x, 3).when~(c)
process 0 frames=8 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000] c=[true true false true false true true true]
@ a condition of the kind block is read once for each call of process: the calls cut where the delay stops and runs again
process 0 params c=true frames=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000]
process 0 params c=false frames=2 in x=[0x40a00000 0x40c00000]
process 0 params c=true frames=2 in x=[0x40e00000 0x41000000]
@ delay~(x, 2).reset_if~(r) puts the values and the write position back before the stages of the frame, and the frame gives its own input
process 0 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] r=[false false true false false false]
process 1 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] r=[false false true true false false]
@ a reset puts the delay back to its init (a literal or a value of the kind init), not to T.default()
process 0 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] r=[false false true false false false]
process 1 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] r=[false false true false false false]
@ the order of the two modifiers: x.when~(c).reset_if~(r) resets the stopped frames and the held output too, x.reset_if~(r).when~(c) only the frames that run

process 0 frames=8 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000] c=[true true false true false false true true] r=[false false true true false true false false]

process 1 frames=8 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000] c=[true true false true false false true true] r=[false false true true false true false false]
@ vdelay~: the argument d is the caller's and is evaluated at the stopped frames too, the interpolation counts the runs
process 0 frames=8 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000] c=[true true false true false true true true]
@ in a par~: each copy has its own delay, stopped by the same condition
process 0 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] c=[true true false true false true]
@ a delay in the first argument of a delay, with the modifier on the inner or on the outer one
process 0 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] c=[true false true true false true]
process 1 frames=6 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000] c=[true false true true false true]
@ a first argument at sample / 4: the delay ticks at the grid, the condition is read there, and a stopped tick is no tick of the delay
@ a reset_if~ whose condition is slower than the delay resets before the stage of the delay at that frame
@ a slow delay with a reset_if~ slower than its tick: the grid of sample / 16 is every 4th tick of the delay
@ a slower reset_if~ inside a when~: its grid counts the ticks that the delay ran, not the ticks of the caller (§11.9)
@ the calls of process cut the frames anywhere, a call of 0 frames too, and a reset starts over (§13.4, §11.6)
process 0 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000] c=[true] r=[false]
process 0 frames=2 in x=[0x40000000 0x40400000] c=[true false] r=[false true]
process 0 frames=0 in x=[] c=[] r=[]
process 0 frames=2 in x=[0x40800000 0x40a00000] c=[true false] r=[true false]
process 0 frames=3 in x=[0x40c00000 0x40e00000 0x41000000] c=[false true true] r=[true false false]
process 1 frames=3 in x=[0x42ca0000 0x42ca0000 0x42ca0000] c=[true true true] r=[false false false]

process 2 frames=3 in x=[0x42ca0000 0x42ca0000 0x42ca0000] c=[true true true]
